labels.name: enhancement
labels.rationale: Feature request for a new generic SpeedColumn in rich/progress.py

items.body:
This is a feature request. Rich accepts new features only after they are approved in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions), so please open a discussion there first.

Rich has no generic speed column yet. `TransferSpeedColumn` covers bytes, and `TaskProgressColumn(show_speed=True)` only shows speed when `total` is unknown. A custom column that subclasses [`ProgressColumn`](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/rich/progress.py) can already render `task.speed` in any unit.

Related earlier reports: #3835 and #304.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
